ERASERHEAD XIU XIU live

Πέμπτη 2 Απριλίου στις 20:00 | Δαναός

The screen flickers and the sound arrives from somewhere you can't quite locate. You're sitting in Danaos Cinema, but what's happening isn't quite film and isn't quite concert. Xiu Xiu is performing their score to Eraserhead, and reality is becoming negotiable.

David Lynch's 1977 debut remains one of cinema's most unsettling experiences. The industrial soundscape of the original film created atmosphere as character, the mechanical hums and organic disturbances building a world where horror emerged from the everyday. When Xiu Xiu approached this material, they understood the assignment: create sound that matches Lynch's vision while speaking with their own voice.

Xiu Xiu has spent two decades making music that refuses comfort. Jamie Stewart's project has moved through experimental territories with consistent willingness to disturb, to push toward emotional registers that most artists avoid. Their Eraserhead score brings this sensibility to Lynch's imagery, the film becoming even more alien through their sonic filter.

Danaos Cinema provides the appropriate venue. The historic Athens cinema offers the screen scale that Eraserhead requires, the darkness that the film needs to work its effects. The sound system handles the score's demands, from whispered drones to industrial assault.

The crowd for this event self-selects with precision. You'll find Lynch devotees who know every frame of Eraserhead, Xiu Xiu fans who've followed the band's experimental journey, and the generally curious who've heard this is something not to miss. The common quality is willingness, openness to an experience that won't conform to expectations.

What happens when Xiu Xiu scores Eraserhead live is neither film screening nor concert but hybrid event. The music responds to the imagery in real time, the performance aspect adding spontaneity to what could be mechanical synchronization. By the final frames, you've experienced something that can't be replicated through home viewing.

If you need comfort and accessibility, this event offers their opposites. Eraserhead disturbs. Xiu Xiu disturbs. Together they multiply disturbance into art. But if you're ready for cinema as confrontation, if you want to understand what experimental sound can do to experimental image, you find your seat at Danaos.
